frozen_contract.question: does the bounded-risk admission gate change Target-local adaptation, Skill formation, and held-out utility, relative to the strict 20/20 gate?
frozen_contract.not_tested_here: cross-domain accumulation benefit: both online arms carry the same audited Source card and it is applicable at none of this study's origins, so the accumulation treatment is empty and no arm difference could express it

source_treatment.reading: the audited Source card is installed in both arms and is applicable at no origin in this study; it is correctly silent, and the accumulation treatment is therefore empty
source_treatment.arm_names_are_historical: the arms are coded A5-strict / A5-bounded for continuity with P2-P4; read them as Online-strict / Online-bounded, since neither arm's Source knowledge activates here

scope_match_gate_for_a_real_a5_study.requirement: at least 1 pre-audited Source Skill must match the deployment-visible context of at least one held-in origin
scope_match_gate_for_a_real_a5_study.inadmissible_way_to_pass: widening an existing card's observable_applicability so it matches; that manufactures the treatment instead of finding it

geometry.rule: greedy on the 48-step grid, minimum spacing 240, skipping origins whose context window is not evaluable
geometry.viability_screen: structural: the Consumer's robust scale on [origin-192, origin) must not collapse to its floor for any evaluation series; reads observed history only, no Outcome

bounded_budget.scope: pooled_ridge_a1 + sMASE only; does not transfer

offline_sensitivity_point.method: offline re-read of the collected per-series log; no new run

statistics.aggregation: mean over the 3 replicas within an origin, then paired
statistics.interval: BCa bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, clustered on origin
statistics.power_note: n=8: the smallest attainable two-sided p is 0.0078 and p<0.05 needs W<=3, so only a near-unanimous sign split can reach significance; a neutral verdict means undetectable here, not zero
